reason: Conversation 2 immediately connected the sink replacement to backflow, asked exactly the right questions (hose routing and sink drainage), identified the missing high loop on the first customer answer, and correctly flagged the slow-draining trap as a secondary fix while explicitly deprioritising pump/non-return valve faults.
